title: Add fail-closed market candidate recovery gate
guarantees: Marketplace search hits are classified before they can become sale evidence.
Exact card identity and exact historical sale-event matching are separate gates.
A later active relisting of the exact serial-numbered card cannot verify an earlier sale.
Only historical-sale-match candidates may be converted into evidence schema v2.
Candidate assessment cannot mutate market records, realized sale prices, EV values or verification flags.
Product/card identity matching is centralized in one shared module used by evidence ingest, task generation and market-record audit.
